description: Convert any image to a base64 data URL in your browser — with preview, size comparison, copy and download.

faqs.a: The file is read with FileReader.readAsDataURL and the resulting data:image/...;base64,... string is shown, ready to paste into CSS, HTML or JSON.
Base64 inflates size by ~33% — the tool shows both sizes so you can judge whether embedding is worth it.
faqs.q: Why is the output bigger than the file?

faqs.a: data URLs are great for tiny icons and one-off embeds, but large images are better served as separate files for caching.
faqs.q: When should I use a data URL?

faqs.a: Yes — the file never leaves your device; conversion happens entirely in your browser.

howto: See the preview, the data URL and the size comparison.
Copy the data URL or download it as a text file.
title: Image to Base64 Converter
